rationale: I reviewed the C7 docs-tooling repair against HEAD a03d0fef28b9d6e225d0001a55def1f0267aa3a4 without modifying anything. Only the three in-scope files changed. In docs/site/package.json there are two override edits: follow-redirects is added at 1.16.1 and launch-editor goes from 2.14.1 to 2.14.2. In docs/site/package-lock.json only the follow-redirects and launch-editor entries changed (version, resolved and integrity), plus launch-editor's declared shell-quote range, which moved from ^1.8.4 to ^1.10.0. The resolved shell-quote is still 1.12.0 with the same integrity, and 1.12.0 satisfies the new range. These versions match the fixed releases you gave for GHSA-q3jh-wrc6-jgq8 and GHSA-8r9p-f939-6h3c (1.16.1) and for GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm, GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv and GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw (2.14.2). The original CI failure log shows the same five advisories blocked by check-audit.mjs, and it also reports that the braces exception GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm no longer matches. Removing that one exception is therefore what the checker itself asked for. The other changes are limited to the exceptions file, which now has an empty list and an unchanged $comment. docs/site/scripts (including check-audit.mjs, check-braces-patch.mjs and check-image-size-patch.mjs), docs/site/vendor and .github show no difference from HEAD. The severity threshold (AUDIT_LEVEL, default moderate) and the fail-closed logic are therefore unchanged. Local evidence after the change shows exit code 0 for npm ci, npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), docs:security (both vendored-patch checks PASS, 0 advisories, 0 allowed by exception) and docs:check. npm ls shows follow-redirects@1.16.1 and launch-editor@2.14.2. This is local validation only: there is not yet a new CI success.

The CI failure reported 3 flagged entries, while the local pre-change audit reported 2. Both runs list the same five blocking advisories, so this does not affect the fix, but CI should confirm a clean audit on the actual runner.
